en.content:
A solution of phenol in chloroform when treated with aqueous NaOH gives compound P as a major product. The mass percentage of carbon in P is ______. (to the nearest integer)
(Atomic mass : C = 12; H = 1; O = 16)
en.explanation:
mass of Salicylaldehyde = 12 × 7 + 6 × 1 + 16 × 2 = 122

mass of carbon = 12 × 7 = 84

mass % of C in P = 100

= 68.85 % 69 %

Fehling’s test

of D(+)-galactose

Lactose (C<sub>11</sub>H<sub>22</sub>O<sub>11</sub>) is a disaccharide and it
contains 8 hydroxyl groups
